description: projects.getProjectDomains (GET /v9/projects/{idOrName}/domains) omits the 404 the live API returns when the project itself is gone, so the typed union lacks NotFound. The ProjectDomain resource's read path observes domains on a possibly-deleted project and branches on a typed NotFound tag; without it the 404 surfaces as the catch-all. Add the 404 response so the generator attaches the status-class NotFound error.
